settings row of the web GUI. It is a faithful port of the
dsh-desktop phone-connect
feature."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**This plugin is built for DeepSeek Harness, not for any specific shell

HttpOnly session cookie.
- **Mobile DSH client*"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"* — workspaces, session list, chat history, send prompts,
stop generation; served by the bridge and "},{"id":"p7s4","text":"fully usable over the LAN.

settings row; it shows a **green connection dot** while a phone is paired,
and opens the pairing/m"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"anage dialog (QR + copy + countdown + approve/deny +
disconnect).
- **Safe by default** — private-ne"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"twork-only listener on a random port,
loopback-only desktop endpoints, RPC allowlist (`workspace.lis"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"t`,
`session.list`, `session.history`, `session.create`, `session.prompt`,
`session.cancel`), strict"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"list`, `session.history`, `session.create`, `session.prompt`,
`session.cancel`), strict CSP headers."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Piece | File | Role |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Bridge | `lan-bridge.mjs` | Standalone Node HTTP server on `0.0.0.0` (random port): pairing, mobil"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"e client, RPC forwarding, `/desktop*` JSON/QR endpoints with CORS. |

| Host plugin"},{"id":"p11s4","text":" | `lib/index.js` | Spawns/monitors the bridge (auto-restart, capped), exposes `/phone-connect/bridg"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"e` + `/phone-connect/config`. |
| Client plugin | `lib/client.js` | `__ModuleLoader__` bundle: setti"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ngs-row phone entry (green dot), pairing dialog, copy/countdown/approve UI. |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Install (安装)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Requires a **DeepSeek Harness web profile** (any deployment — the profile
mechanism is core DSH, so "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"this works on plain `dsh web`, Bigfish, desktop
shells that mount a web profile, etc.)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Then restart the harness (or re-boot the profile) so the `cordis.patch.yml`
row mounts. The package "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"depends on `qrcode`, installed automatically by the
profile's package manager."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Shell integration (壳侧整合)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":""Shell" here means the app that hosts the harness around the web profile. The
plugin integrates with"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" the shell at two levels:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### 1. Web GUI shell — built in (无需额外工作)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The plugin's browser half registers into the web profile's own slot system:
the **settings-row phone"},{"id":"p19s2","text":" entry** (with the connected-status dot) and the
**pairing dialog** appear in any DSH web GUI automa"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"tically. A browser-only
deployment needs nothing else."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### 2. Native desktop shells — integration hook provided by the plugin"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"For a desktop shell with its own chrome (e.g., a DSH Desktop-style Electron
app), the shell can add "},{"id":"p21s2","text":"a native entry — a **"Connect Phone…" menu item or
tray action** — that opens the bridge's desktop p"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ry — a **"Connect Phone…" menu item or
tray action** — that opens the bridge's desktop pairing page:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- The host plugin publishes the bridge snapshot at `GET /phone-connect/bridge`,
including `desktopUr"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"l` (`http://127.0.0.1:<port>/desktop`, loopback-only).
- That page is the full pairing/manage UI (QR"},{"id":"p22s3","text":", auto-refresh, approve/deny,
disconnect) — exactly what dsh-desktop shows in its own Electron windo"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"w.
- A shell can therefore discover the URL with one same-origin HTTP call and
open it in a small wi"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"ndow — **no configuration, no credentials**."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Can DeepSeek Harness do this? / DeepSeek Harness 能做到吗？"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Yes.** Every runtime piece the plugin needs is core DeepSeek Harness
capability available to any p"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"rofile: the profile-plugin mechanism
(`cordis.patch.yml` + `dsh plugin add`), `webServer` route regi"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"stration,
the `subprocess` service, the standalone LAN bridge, and the browser-side
slot system. Not"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"hing in this plugin depends on a particular shell app."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The **one** thing a plugin cannot do from inside the harness is inject native
menu items into a desk"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"top shell's own menu bar — that chrome belongs to the
shell's code (it is exactly how dsh-desktop sh"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ips its "Harness → Connect
Phone…" item natively). For that case the plugin provides the
`desktopUrl"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"` hook above, and the shell wires a menu/tray item to it."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"1. Open the web GUI and find the **phone icon** at the right end of the
**settings row** (bottom-lef"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"t sidebar).
2. Click it → the pairing dialog opens with a **QR code** (valid 30 minutes;
auto-refres"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"hes on expiry; **Copy** button next to the URL).
3. On your phone, keep it on the **same trusted Wi-"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"Fi**, scan the QR with the
camera (or open the copied URL).
4. The dialog shows the pending phone — "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"click **允许 / Allow**.
5. The phone opens the mobile DSH client. The connection stays active in the

clients (`10/8`, `172.16/1"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"2`, `192.168/16`, ULA/link-local IPv6).
- `/desktop*` endpoints are **loopback-only**; CORS is grant"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ed only to the
harness GUI origin.
- Pairing token: 32 random bytes, **timing-safe** comparison, 30-"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"minute TTL.
- Phone sessions: HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie.
- The mobile client can only call th"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"e **allowlisted** RPC methods.
- **Keep it on a network you trust.** Remove the `dsh-mobile` row fro"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"m
`cordis.patch.yml` (or uninstall) when you do not need phone access."}],"truncated":true}
